body: Kwa kila mfanyakazi: NSSF ya mwajiri = 10% x TZS 400,000 = TZS 40,000. Jumla ya michango ya wafanyakazi 5: 40,000 x 5 = TZS 200,000. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.
guards_against: the 2x-total assumption collided with a per-employee SALARY; body is correct

body: Mshahara kamili: TZS 2,500,000. Sehemu ya mwajiri: TZS 2,500,000 x 10% = TZS 250,000. Sehemu ya mfanyakazi: TZS 2,500,000 x 10% = TZS 250,000. Jumla ya michango: TZS 250,000 + TZS 250,000 = TZS 500,000. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.
guards_against: CORRECT body stating sum AND share; a presence rule would blank it

body: NSSF (sehemu ya mwajiri): TZS 800,000 x 10% = TZS 80,000. Jumla ya NSSF: TZS 80,000 (mwajiri) + TZS 80,000 (mfanyakazi) = TZS 160,000.
guards_against: CORRECT on NSSF, total under a neutral sum label

body: Kiwango cha michango ya NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Kwa mshahara wa TZS 650,000, unapaswa kulipa TZS 130,000 kwa NSSF (sehemu ya mwajiri ni TZS 65,000 na sehemu ya mfanyakazi ni TZS 65,000). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
guards_against: nat_08 live after the router fix -- the total offered as the asker own obligation

body: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000, mwajiri unachangia asilimia 10 (TZS 80,000). Mfanyakazi anakatwa asilimia 10 (TZS 80,000). Jumla ya michango ni TZS 160,000 kwa mwezi.
guards_against: rc_01: CORRECT answer to a two-part question; must not be blanked

body: NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi, kwa hiyo kwa TZS 500,000 utalipa TZS 50,000 kwa upande wa mwajiri na TZS 50,000 kwa upande wa mfanyakazi.
guards_against: THE TWO BODIES A GENERIC CONNECTOR WIDENING WOULD HAVE BLANKED. party=total, so the precondition must exclude it outright

body: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 650,000, unapaswa kulipa TZS 65,000 kwa NSSF.
guards_against: an obligation verb governing the AUTHORITATIVE figure is the faithful body -- the rule must key on the TOTAL, not on the construction alone

body: Sehemu yako ni TZS 65,000. Jumla ya michango ya pande zote ni TZS 130,000.
guards_against: the total under a neutral label, correct body -- the 4-for-1 case, must stay silent

body: Unapaswa kujua kwamba kiwango ni asilimia 20. Jumla ya pande zote, ikijumuisha sehemu ya mwajiri na ya mfanyakazi kwa pamoja, ni TZS 130,000.
guards_against: the {0,3}-word window must not reach across a whole clause to a neutrally-labelled total

body: Kama mwajiri unatakiwa kulipa TZS 120,000 kwa NSSF kwa mshahara wa TZS 600,000.
